verdict.rationale: Zero is an email client, so open-protocol access and standards-based export are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence never mentions IMAP, JMAP, SMTP, or any export format such as mbox or EML. It shows provider integrations like Gmail via Google OAuth, self-hosting, and an MCP capability list, which are related features rather than the open-protocol access and export this story asks for.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in
